The '''Ewok Tree Village''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] village on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] which belonged to a tribe of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] known as the [[Panshee]]. It was located a relatively short distance to the northeast of the moon's [[Research Outpost]], in the forests of the [[Jiberah Plains]].<ref name="SWG:ETV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok Tree Village was a designated [[W:c:swg:Point of interest|point of interest]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ETV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was one of two [[W:c:swg:Ewok|Ewok]] tree villages on [[W:c:swg:Endor|Endor]]. When visited, players would receive an [[W:c:swg:Exploration badges|exploration badge]]. In the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|game]], both villages were simply called an "Ewok Tree Village,"<ref name="SWG:ETV" /> however the game's directory tree files and source data give the more specific name of '''Southeast Panshee Ewok Village'''.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref>
